summary: P01 V2.47.225 is the Software one-page Production R8 mature catalog polish after Owner review of V2.47.224. It keeps the approved one-page IA while removing the remaining dashboard/data-grid feel: decorative eyebrow, repeated directory total pill, repeated group icon boxes and per-card platform metadata are removed; only useful official-source provenance remains; selection reads as a direct checkbox; typography and card hierarchy are strengthened while descriptions stay to two readable lines; normal desktop remains four columns and large desktop five. Canonical Start data authority, schema, authentication/security semantics, updater mechanism, provider/server state and Production runtime remain unchanged. Production remains Owner-manual.
